description.id: Log viewer dan halaman ops yang selalu dibutuhkan aplikasi Laravel, dalam satu halaman di /debugger.
description.en: A log viewer and the ops pages every Laravel app ends up needing, on one page at /debugger.

note.id: Di production, debugger berjalan dalam mode baca-saja dan hanya terbuka untuk orang yang Anda izinkan lewat gate viewDebugger.
note.en: In production the debugger runs read-only and only opens for the people you allow through the viewDebugger gate.

description.id: Satu daftar yang menunjukkan bagian mana yang perlu dicek.
description.en: One list that shows which parts need a look.

description.id: Baca file log dengan filter level, pencarian dan stack trace yang rapi.
description.en: Read log files with level filters, search and a readable stack trace.

description.id: Lihat failed job beserta exception-nya, lalu retry atau hapus.
description.en: See failed jobs with their exception, then retry or delete them.

description.id: Task terjadwal, jadwal berikutnya, dan riwayat tiap run.
description.en: Scheduled tasks, when they run next, and a history of every run.

description.id: Kosongkan cache aplikasi, config, route dan view tanpa membuka terminal.
description.en: Clear the application, config, route and view caches without a terminal.

description.id: Kirim email tes lewat queue atau langsung untuk mengecek setting mailer.
description.en: Send a test email through the queue or right away to check the mailer.

description.id: Upload file tes ke disk dan cek apakah disk bisa ditulis dan dibaca.
description.en: Upload a test file to a disk and check that disks can be written and read.

description.id: Ping API eksternal yang dipakai aplikasi dan lihat jawabannya.
description.en: Ping the external APIs your app calls and see how they answer.

description.id: Masuk sebagai user lain untuk melihat aplikasi seperti yang mereka lihat.
description.en: Log in as another user to see the app the way they see it.
